Mission & Monday

Odessa, TX · Road

Beginner friendly

Mission & Monday is a road group ride in Odessa, TX. It rolls every Monday at 6:15 pm from Mission Fitness. About 12 (repeatable out-and-back) miles.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Mission & Monday group ride

A Monday evening ride organized by the West Texas Gazelles in Odessa. The course is a 12-mile out-and-back. You can turn early or do it more than once. Check the Gazelles' Facebook group for updates.
